actions.name: open_a_box
actions.text: a person holds both hands low in front and pulls them apart outward
paraphrases: a person moves both hands apart at waist height in front of the body
a person bends forward slightly and spreads both hands outward over a low point
a person uses both hands in front of the hips to pull something open
actions.motion: Both hands come together in front of the waist or lower, with the torso leaning slightly forward and the head tilted down. The hands then move apart sideways and slightly upward, sometimes repeated for each side. The legs stay mostly still and the torso returns to upright at the end.

phases.start: both hands reach to a point in front of the waist
phases.middle: hands pull apart sideways and upward

confusable_with.name: put_object_into_bag
confusable_with.visible_difference: one hand moves down into a single spot instead of both hands spreading apart

confusable_with.name: take_object_out_of_bag
confusable_with.visible_difference: one hand lifts up out of a low spot rather than both hands moving apart

confusable_with.name: tear_up_paper
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands pull apart at chest height in repeated short motions

actions.name: move_heavy_objects
actions.text: a person bends down and drags or pushes something low with both hands
paraphrases: a person crouches, holds a low point with both hands, and leans to shift it
a person squats with both arms down and pulls backward with body weight
a person bends at the hips and moves both hands low while stepping
actions.motion: The person bends at the hips and knees so both hands reach near the floor in front. Both arms stay low and close together while the torso leans to push or pull, often with small steps of the feet sideways or backward. The body stays low through the middle and rises toward upright at the end.

phases.start: bends down and places both hands low
phases.middle: leans and shifts body weight with small steps

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands rise with the body to standing instead of staying low while stepping

confusable_with.name: squat_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands do not reach forward to the floor and the body does not lean to push or pull

confusable_with.name: pushing
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms push forward at chest height against a second person

actions.name: shake_fist
actions.text: a person raises the right hand and shakes it in short strokes
paraphrases: a person lifts the right fist near the head and jerks it repeatedly
a person holds the right arm bent up and moves the fist back and forth
a person shakes a raised right fist in short repeated motions toward the front
actions.motion: The right arm bends and lifts so the hand is at shoulder or head height in front of the body. The right hand then moves in short, quick back-and-forth or up-and-down strokes, repeated several times, while the elbow stays bent. The rest of the body stays mostly still and the arm lowers at the end.

phases.start: right arm lifts with elbow bent
phases.middle: hand moves in short repeated strokes

confusable_with.name: hand_waving
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand sweeps side to side in a wider arc

confusable_with.name: cheer_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: both arms rise high above the head

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: a single forward strike that reaches a second person

actions.name: throw_up_cap_hat
actions.text: a person takes something from the head and tosses it upward with one hand
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand from the head and flings it upward
a person grabs at the top of the head then throws the arm upward
a person tosses something high into the air after removing it from the head
actions.motion: The right hand rises to the top of the head, then the arm swings forward and upward quickly until it is extended above the head. The head and torso may tilt back slightly to follow the upward throw. The arm then lowers, sometimes with both hands rising again as if to catch.

phases.start: right hand reaches to the top of the head
phases.middle: arm swings fast upward above the head
phases.end: arm lowers or both hands rise to catch

confusable_with.name: take_off_a_hat_cap
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand goes to the head and comes down without a fast upward swing

confusable_with.name: throw
confusable_with.visible_difference: arm swings forward from the shoulder without first touching the head

confusable_with.name: cheer_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: both arms rise overhead together without a hand going to the head first

actions.name: capitulate
actions.text: a person raises both hands up beside the head as in surrender
paraphrases: a person lifts both arms with bent elbows so hands are at head height
a person puts both hands up near the head and holds them still
a person surrenders by raising both hands to the sides of the head
actions.motion: Both arms lift together from the sides, elbows bent, until the hands are beside or slightly above the head. The hands are held still in this position for a while. The torso and legs stay upright and still, and the arms may lower at the end.

phases.start: both arms rise from the sides
phases.middle: hands held still beside the head

confusable_with.name: cheer_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms extend fully overhead and often move or shake

confusable_with.name: stretch_oneself
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms push fully up with the torso extending or leaning

confusable_with.name: put_on_headphone
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands move to the sides of the head and touch the ears

actions.name: cross_arms
actions.text: a person folds both arms across the chest and holds them there
paraphrases: a person crosses the forearms in front of the chest and stays still
a person brings each hand to the opposite upper arm across the chest
a person stands with arms folded over the chest in a held pose
actions.motion: Both arms bend and move toward the center of the chest, with each hand going toward the opposite elbow or upper arm. The forearms overlap horizontally against the chest and stay there with little motion. The rest of the body stays upright and still.

phases.middle: forearms cross and rest over the chest
phases.end: held still in the folded pose

confusable_with.name: cross_hands_in_front
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms cross further out from the body in an X shape

confusable_with.name: chest_pain
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands press on the chest and the torso bends forward

confusable_with.name: hugging
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms wrap around a second person

actions.name: arm_circles
actions.text: a person stretches both arms out to the sides and rotates them in circles
paraphrases: a person holds arms straight sideways and moves them around in repeated loops
a person swings both outstretched arms in round circles from the shoulders
a person circles both straight arms repeatedly while standing still
actions.motion: Both arms lift out to the sides to about shoulder height and stay straight. The hands trace repeated circles around the shoulders, forward or backward, with both arms moving together. The torso and legs stay still while the circling continues several times before the arms drop.

phases.start: arms lift straight out to the sides
phases.middle: hands trace repeated circles around the shoulders

confusable_with.name: arm_swings
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms swing back and forth or across the body instead of tracing circles

confusable_with.name: fan_self
confusable_with.visible_difference: only one hand waves near the face

confusable_with.name: stretch_oneself
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms extend once and hold rather than circling repeatedly

actions.name: arm_swings
actions.text: a person swings both straight arms back and forth across the body repeatedly
paraphrases: a person moves both arms in big repeated swings in front of the chest
a person opens arms out wide then swings them across the chest repeatedly
a person swings the arms forward and backward over and over while standing
actions.motion: Both arms stay mostly straight and swing together, either opening out to the sides and then crossing in front of the chest, or swinging forward and back past the hips. The movement repeats rhythmically many times. The torso may twist slightly with the swings while the legs stay planted.

phases.middle: arms swing across the body or back and forth repeatedly
phases.end: arms come to rest at the sides

confusable_with.name: arm_circles
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands trace full circles at shoulder height

confusable_with.name: clapping
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands meet repeatedly in front of the chest with elbows bent

confusable_with.name: cross_hands_in_front
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms cross once and hold still

actions.name: run_on_the_spot
actions.text: a person jogs in place, lifting knees alternately while arms swing
paraphrases: a person runs without moving forward, raising each foot in turn quickly
a person alternately lifts left and right legs fast while staying in place
a person pumps bent arms and lifts the knees in a running rhythm
actions.motion: The legs alternate quickly, with each knee lifting forward and the foot leaving the ground while the other foot supports the body. The bent arms swing forward and back opposite to the legs. The whole body bounces slightly up and down in rhythm but stays in the same spot.

phases.start: first knee lifts and arms start pumping
phases.middle: fast alternating leg lifts with arm swings

confusable_with.name: butt_kicks
confusable_with.visible_difference: heels swing back toward the buttocks instead of knees lifting forward

confusable_with.name: hopping
confusable_with.visible_difference: one leg stays lifted while the other repeatedly jumps

confusable_with.name: jump_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: both feet leave the ground at the same time

actions.name: butt_kicks
actions.text: a person jogs in place kicking each heel back toward the buttocks
paraphrases: a person alternately bends each knee to bring the heel up behind
a person raises the feet behind the body one after another in place
a person flicks each lower leg backward so the heel nears the hip
actions.motion: The legs alternate, each knee bending so the foot moves backward and upward until the heel is near the buttocks, while the thigh stays mostly vertical. The other leg supports the body and the movement repeats quickly in place. The arms may swing bent at the sides or rest on the hips.

phases.end: both feet back on the ground

confusable_with.name: run_on_the_spot
confusable_with.visible_difference: knees lift forward in front instead of heels moving back

confusable_with.name: hopping
confusable_with.visible_difference: one foot stays up while the body jumps on the other

confusable_with.name: side_kick
confusable_with.visible_difference: one leg extends out to the side
